MalGanisFelClawsWillOfTichondrius.name: Will of Tichondrius
MalGanisFelClawsWillOfTichondrius.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Fel Claws to permanently increase Fel Claw's damage by 0.25. MalGanisNecroticEmbraceWingedGuard.name: Winged Guard
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceWingedGuard.description: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack. If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 5 seconds.

MalGanisVampiricTouchTimeToFeed.name: Time to Feed
MalGanisVampiricTouchTimeToFeed.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceMightOfSargeras.name: Might of Sargeras
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceMightOfSargeras.description: Necrotic Embrace now provides 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceEchoOfDoom.name: Echo of Doom
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceEchoOfDoom.description: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

MalGanisVampiricTouchVampiricAura.name: Vampiric Aura
MalGanisVampiricTouchVampiricAura.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 40% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 20% of Physical Damage dealt.

MalGanisFelClawsBlackClaws.name: Black Claws
MalGanisFelClawsBlackClaws.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

MalGanisNecroticEmbraceFueledByTorment.name: Fueled by Torment
MalGanisNecroticEmbraceFueledByTorment.description: Necrotic Embrace now Slows nearby enemies by 25% for 3 seconds.

MalGanisNightRushSpreadingPlague.name: Spreading Plague
MalGanisNightRushSpreadingPlague.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration. Does not wake Sleeping targets.

MalGanisCarrionSwarm.name: Carrion Swarm
MalGanisCarrionSwarm.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 damage per second to enemies. Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

MalGanisDarkConversion.name: Dark Conversion
MalGanisDarkConversion.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

MalGanisNightRushDeepSleep.name: Deep Sleep
MalGanisNightRushDeepSleep.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 15%.

MalGanisNightRushTheNightBeckons.name: The Night Beckons
MalGanisNightRushTheNightBeckons.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

MalGanisVampiricTouchBloodRush.name: Blood Rush
MalGanisVampiricTouchBloodRush.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

MalGanisNecroticEmbracePlagueBats.name: Plague Bats
MalGanisNecroticEmbracePlagueBats.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 damage.

MalGanisVampiricTouchFrenziedAssault.name: Frenzied Assault
MalGanisVampiricTouchFrenziedAssault.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt. Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

MalGanisFelClawsBlindAsABat.name: Blind as a Bat
MalGanisFelClawsBlindAsABat.description: Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 5.5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds. Does not provide quest stacks while active.

MalGanisCarrionSwarmSeekerSwarm.name: Seeker Swarm
MalGanisCarrionSwarmSeekerSwarm.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

MalGanisDarkConversionWrathOfNathreza.name: Wrath of Nathreza
MalGanisDarkConversionWrathOfNathreza.description: Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 85% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds. Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

MalGanisFelClawsVanquishTheWeak.name: Vanquish the Weak
MalGanisFelClawsVanquishTheWeak.description: Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.

MalGanisNightRushAloneInTheDark.name: Alone in the Dark
MalGanisNightRushAloneInTheDark.description: Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.
